test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which ministry released a draft of 'National Air Sports Policy (NASP)' for public feedback on January 2, 2022?

options.text: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Civil Aviation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Air Sports Policy (NASP)**

 
 
• **​**The government of India intends **to promote the air sports industry** in India by investing in technology and infrastructure, focusing on quality and safety, simplifying processes and systems, training, and raising awareness, as outlined in the draft National Air Sports Policy (NASP) 2022.
 
• The NASP's primary goal is to increase air sports' safety, affordability, accessibility, sustainability, and enjoyment in India.
 
• **By 2030**, the Indian government intends to make India a leading air sports nation.
 
• It will cover paragliding, aerobatics, aeromodelling, ballooning, drones, gliding, hang gliding, skydiving, microlighting, paramotoring, and vintage aircraft, as well as **amateur-built and experimental aircraft.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Features of National Air Sports Policy (NASP)**

 
 
• ​A** governance structure** with two levels: The** Air Sports Federation of India (AFSI)** and the associations for each air sport will be part of this.
 
• **Role of AFSI**: It will be the summit overseeing body. It will represent India at international air sports events like the **Fédération Aéronautique Internationale (FAI).**
 
• **Associations for each air sport**: The day-to-day operations will be handled by these organizations, such as the **Paragliding Association of India or the Skydiving Association of India**, among others.
 
• The FAI's guidelines will be followed at all air sports competitions in India. 
 
• The NASP 2022 places an emphasis on ensuring international best practices in safety because air sports involve a **higher level of risk than flying a regular aircraft.**
